Who: member. Every active member reads the catalog (D37). Filters: departmentId, q (code or title); combined with AND. Ordered by code, then id.

delete.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments). 409 when the course still has sections.

post.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments). CSV header row required, case-insensitive. Columns: required departmentCode, code, title; optional credits (0 to 20, one decimal; empty means 3.0; ignored for existing courses). Max 5 MiB. Errors: details has one entry per bad row (field line:<n>), checksum mismatch is field checksum, file problems are field file. Row messages: "code is required", "title is required", "code must be at most 20 characters", "title must be at most 200 characters", "unknown department code <X>", "department <X> is not managed by you", "credits must be a number", "credits must have at most 1 decimal", "credits must be between 0 and 20". Existing rows are never updated.

Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments). CSV header row required, case-insensitive. Columns: required departmentCode, code, title; optional credits (0 to 20, one decimal; empty means 3.0; ignored for existing courses). Max 5 MiB. Errors: details has one entry per bad row (field line:<n>), checksum mismatch is field checksum, file problems are field file. Row messages: "code is required", "title is required", "code must be at most 20 characters", "title must be at most 200 characters", "unknown department code <X>", "department <X> is not managed by you", "credits must be a number", "credits must have at most 1 decimal", "credits must be between 0 and 20". Existing rows are never updated.

get.description: Who: member. Every active member reads every section of the university (D37). pendingStaff is [] for plain members. Filters: termId, courseId, departmentId (the course's department), q (course code or title); all combine with AND. Ordered by course code, then section number, then term start, then id.

post.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments). meetings is optional, at most 20 rows (400 field meetings, "add at most 20 meeting times"); rows on the same weekday whose times intersect are 400 field meetings ("Meeting 1 and meeting 3 overlap on Monday."), and endsAt is exclusive, so 10:00-11:00 and 11:00-12:00 are fine; per row errors use field meetings[<i>].weekday, .startsAt, .endsAt, .location (0-based, in the order sent), e.g. "must be after startsAt".

patch.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments). meetings, when present, replaces the whole list; [] clears it; omitted (or null) keeps it. Validation as on create.

get.description: Who: member. Any active member reads a section; rosters stay staff-only. pendingStaff is [] for a plain member who is not staff on the section.

post.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments). CSV header row required, case-insensitive. Columns: required courseCode, termName, number; optional instructorEmails, taEmails (semicolon-separated), meetings (semicolon-separated slots "Mon 10:00-11:15 @ Room 101"; weekday Mon..Sun, case-insensitive; 24-hour HH:MM; "@ location" optional). Max 5 MiB. Errors: details has one entry per bad row (field line:<n>), checksum mismatch is field checksum, file problems are field file. Row messages: "number is required", "number must be at most 20 characters", "unknown course code <X>", "unknown term <X>", "course <X> is not in a department you manage", "invalid email <raw>", "<email> listed as both instructor and ta", "<email>: membership is not active", "meeting \"<slot>\" must look like Mon 10:00-11:15 @ Room 101", "meeting \"<slot>\": unknown weekday <X>", "meeting \"<slot>\": <field> <message>", "at most 20 meetings". An existing section is never changed; instructors, TAs and invitations missing from it are added (action add/invite, message "section exists; adds staff"); listed staff keep their current role. Meetings are written for a new section, or an existing one that has none (message "section exists; adds meetings"); an existing section's meetings are never changed (message "section exists; keeps meetings").

Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments). CSV header row required, case-insensitive. Columns: required courseCode, termName, number; optional instructorEmails, taEmails (semicolon-separated), meetings (semicolon-separated slots "Mon 10:00-11:15 @ Room 101"; weekday Mon..Sun, case-insensitive; 24-hour HH:MM; "@ location" optional). Max 5 MiB. Errors: details has one entry per bad row (field line:<n>), checksum mismatch is field checksum, file problems are field file. Row messages: "number is required", "number must be at most 20 characters", "unknown course code <X>", "unknown term <X>", "course <X> is not in a department you manage", "invalid email <raw>", "<email> listed as both instructor and ta", "<email>: membership is not active", "meeting \"<slot>\" must look like Mon 10:00-11:15 @ Room 101", "meeting \"<slot>\": unknown weekday <X>", "meeting \"<slot>\": <field> <message>", "at most 20 meetings", "Meeting <i> and meeting <j> overlap on <Weekday>." (slots numbered 1-based in cell order; endsAt is exclusive). An existing section is never changed; instructors, TAs and invitations missing from it are added (action add/invite, message "section exists; adds staff"); listed staff keep their current role. Meetings are written for a new section, or an existing one that has none (message "section exists; adds meetings"); an existing section's meetings are never changed (message "section exists; keeps meetings").

get.description: Who: admin, dept_admin of the course's department, staff and enrolled members. Accepted staff only; invited staff are in Section.pendingStaff.

post.description: Who: admin, dept_admin; instructor of the section for ta rows. Instructors may only send role ta. 409: already staff; invitation already pending for this section; user is already a member (invited membership).

202.description: Email has no active membership; invitation created

delete.description: Who: admin, dept_admin; instructor of the section for ta rows.

Who: admin, dept_admin; instructor of the section for ta rows. Deletes only the pending row for this section; the invitation stays (revoke it with deleteInvitation). 404 when the invitation has no pending row on this section.

get.description: Who: admin, dept_admin; staff of the section (instructors and TAs).

post.description: Who: admin, dept_admin. CSV header row required, case-insensitive. Columns: required email; optional displayName. Max 5 MiB. Errors: details has one entry per bad row (field line:<n>), checksum mismatch is field checksum, file problems are field file. displayName (optional, at most 100 characters) fills an empty name and never replaces a set one: on commit an added member's own name, or the invitation's name for an invited person, applied when they first sign in. Rows that already exist change nothing. Row messages: "invalid email", "membership is not active", "domain not allowed", "displayName must be at most 100 characters".

Who: admin, dept_admin. CSV header row required, case-insensitive. Columns: required email; optional displayName. Max 5 MiB. Errors: details has one entry per bad row (field line:<n>), checksum mismatch is field checksum, file problems are field file. displayName (optional, at most 100 characters) fills an empty name and never replaces a set one: on commit an added member's own name, or the invitation's name for an invited person, applied when they first sign in. Rows that already exist change nothing. Row messages: "invalid email", "membership is not active", "domain not allowed", "displayName must be at most 100 characters".

get.description: Who: member.

put.description: Who: admin. Replaces every row. Errors: rows (count 1 to 50, or "must include a row with minPercent 0"), rows[<i>].letter, rows[<i>].minPercent, rows[<i>].points, including "duplicate letter" and "duplicate minPercent". Existing final grades never change. 409 when a concurrent replace won.

get.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments), instructor or TA of the section: every assessment; enrolled student: published assessments only.

post.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments), instructor of the section. Errors: name, maxPoints, weight, dueOn, position. 409 when the section already has an assessment with this name. Weights may sum to anything until finalization.

patch.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments), instructor of the section. Sets published, position (reorder), dueOn (null clears). Errors: name, maxPoints, weight, dueOn, position. Changing maxPoints does not re-check existing scores.

delete.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments), instructor of the section. Deletes its scores too; final grades do not change.

put.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments), instructor or TA of the section. Upserts 1 to 500 scores in one transaction: any bad row fails the request. Errors: scores (count), scores[<i>].userId ("must be a uuid", "duplicate userId", "is not enrolled in this section"), scores[<i>].points ("is required", "must be a number", "must have at most 2 decimals", "must be between 0 and <2 x maxPoints>"); points null deletes that score (no error when there was none). Final grades never change. Returns every score of the assessment.

post.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments), instructor or TA of the section. CSV header row required, case-insensitive. Columns: required email, points. Max 5 MiB. Rows: add (no score yet), update (score changes; message "<old> → <new>"), exists (same score), error. Errors: details has one entry per bad row (field line:<n>), checksum mismatch is field checksum, file problems are field file. Row messages: "invalid email", "unknown email", "not enrolled in this section", "points is required", "points must be a number", "points must have at most 2 decimals", "points must be between 0 and <2 x maxPoints>", "duplicate of line <n>".

Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments), instructor or TA of the section. CSV header row required, case-insensitive. Columns: required email, points. Max 5 MiB. Rows: add (no score yet), update (score changes; message "<old> → <new>"), exists (same score), error. Errors: details has one entry per bad row (field line:<n>), checksum mismatch is field checksum, file problems are field file. Row messages: "invalid email", "unknown email", "not enrolled in this section", "points is required", "points must be a number", "points must have at most 2 decimals", "points must be between 0 and <2 x maxPoints>", "duplicate of line <n>".

get.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments), instructor or TA of the section. With Accept: text/csv the response is text/csv; charset=utf-8 (UTF-8 BOM, attachment gradebook.csv): header email, displayName, one column per assessment name (by position), percent, letter, final; one row per student; empty cell when absent; final is the final letter, or incomplete / withdrawn, or empty.
Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments), instructor or TA of the section.

post.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments), instructor of the section. Gives every enrolled student a final grade: weights must sum to 100.00 (else field weights), every assessment becomes published, a missing score counts as 0, the letter comes from the unrounded percent, percent is stored rounded half up to 2 decimals. Overrides apply in the same transaction (fields overrides[<i>].userId, .status, .letter, .reason). 409 when the section is already finalized (reopen first). Body may be {}.

delete.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments), instructor of the section. Deletes every final grade of the section; assessments stay published. 404 when it has none.

patch.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments), instructor of the section. reason is required. letter must be on the scale and needs status graded; points follow the scale row. Switching incomplete or withdrawn back to graded recomputes percent from the current scores (missing = 0) and, without letter, its letter. Body with only reason is 400 field "" ("no fields to update"); an unchanged letter keeps its recorded points.

get.description: Who: member. The caller's sections (enrolled, or holding a final grade) with term and cumulative GPA. Published assessments only.

put.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments), instructor or TA of the section. Plain text, trimmed, at most 10000 characters; empty clears it. Audited as section.update. Errors: description.

get.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments), instructor or TA of the section, enrolled student. Newest first, paginated.

post.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments), instructor or TA of the section. With email (default true) one mail per enrolled student and staff member other than the author is queued in the same transaction; emailed is false when nobody was mailed. Errors: title, body, email.

patch.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments), instructor or TA of the section (any author's announcement). Never sends mail. Errors: title, body; {} is field "" (no fields to update).

delete.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments), instructor or TA of the section. Never sends mail.

get.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments), instructor or TA of the section, enrolled student.

post.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments), instructor or TA of the section. Appended last. Errors: title, notes; weeks when the section already has 100 weeks.

patch.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments), instructor or TA of the section. position moves the week; the others are renumbered 1..n. Errors: title, notes, position; {} is field "".

delete.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments), instructor or TA of the section. Deletes its materials and their files; the remaining weeks are renumbered.

post.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments), instructor or TA of the section. multipart/form-data with one part file and an optional part title; other parts are ignored. Appended last in the week. Errors (the first problem found): file ("must be a multipart/form-data upload", "is required", "must be exactly one file", "must have a file name", "file name must be at most 255 characters", "file name must not contain control characters", "file type not allowed (allowed: csv, doc, docx, gif, jpeg, jpg, md, pdf, png, ppt, pptx, txt, webp, xls, xlsx, zip)", "is empty", "is larger than <limit>" (100 MB by default; see GET /upload-policy), "invalid multipart upload: <reason>"), title, materials when the week already holds 200 files.

patch.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments), instructor or TA of the section. Errors: title, weekId ("is not a week of this section", "week already holds 200 files"), position; {} is field "".

delete.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments), instructor or TA of the section. The file is removed after the deletion commits.

get.description: Who: admin, dept_admin (own departments), instructor or TA of the section, enrolled student. Always an attachment (Content-Disposition attachment; filename*=UTF-8''...), Content-Type from the file type list, ETag "<sha256>", Cache-Control private, no-store, X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, Content-Security-Policy sandbox. Range and If-None-Match are honoured. A file missing on disk is 500.

departmentIds.description: Must be non-empty iff role is dept_admin (else 400 field departmentIds); unknown id is 404.

actor.description: Omitted when the row has no actor (platform CLI).

credits.description: Credit hours, at most one decimal.
At most one decimal. Omitted means 3.0.

invitationId.description: Pass to deleteSectionPendingStaff to cancel this assignment.

PendingStaff.description: Staff invited by email who have not signed in yet.

Meeting.description: One weekly slot; wall-clock time in the university's timezone.

MeetingInput.description: endsAt must be after startsAt. Location is trimmed; omitted means "".

description.example: Lectures Tuesday and Thursday. Office hours on Fridays.
description.description: Plain text, line breaks kept; empty string when unset.

pendingStaff.description: Invitees not signed in yet. [] for callers who may not see them: plain members on GET /sections; plain members who are not staff on the section on GET /sections/{id}; student rows of /me/sections.

meetings.description: The section's weekly meetings; omitted means none.
When present, replaces the whole list ([] clears). Omitted keeps the current meetings.

next.description: Relative path to return to after sign-in; anything else is ignored.

OidcStart.description: Send exactly one of slug or email (else 400 field slug).

next.description: Relative path to return to after sign-in; anything else is ignored.

total.description: Entries matching the current filters, ignoring the cursor and limit.

GradeScaleRowInput.description: Letters unique (exact match after trimming), minPercent unique, at most 2 decimals each.

rows.description: Replaces the whole scale; must include a row with minPercent 0.

kind.description: manual: staff-entered scores (Spec 4). quiz and assignment: Spec 11.

maxPoints.description: A quiz's total is the sum of its question points (1 while it has none).

dueOn.description: Manual: as entered. Quiz and assignment: the date of closesAt in the university's timezone.

kind.description: Omitted means manual. Manual needs admin, dept_admin or instructor; quiz and assignment also allow a TA of the section. Not changeable later.

maxPoints.description: At most 2 decimals. Required for manual and assignment; rejected for a quiz (derived from the questions).

weight.description: At most 2 decimals. Weights may sum to anything until finalization.

dueOn.description: Manual only; rejected for a quiz or assignment (derived from closesAt).

opensAt.description: Required for a quiz or assignment, rejected for manual. RFC 3339.

closesAt.description: Required for a quiz or assignment, rejected for manual. RFC 3339, after opensAt.

position.description: Omitted means after the last assessment.

dueOn.description: null clears the date. Manual only.

closesAt.description: Quizzes and assignments only; after opensAt. Recomputes dueOn.

points.description: At most 2 decimals and at most 2 x maxPoints (bonus). null deletes the student's score.

items.description: Scores of enrolled students, ordered by userId.

credits.description: The course's credits, copied at finalization; the GPA weight.

FinalGradeOverride.description: Set status, letter or both. letter only with status graded (or omitted status); points follow the scale row.

FinalGradeUpdate.description: Set status, letter or both; an unchanged letter keeps its recorded points.

scores.description: assessmentId to points; an assessment without a score is absent.

percent.description: Running percent over the scored assessments (all of them, published or not). Omitted when none is scored or their weights sum to 0.

letter.description: Letter of the unrounded running percent; omitted with percent.

GradebookStats.description: Over each student's final grade when graded, else the running grade; incomplete and withdrawn are left out.

letters.description: Every letter of the scale, 0 when unused.

running.description: Only without final, and only when every assessment scored for the caller is published.

unpublishedCount.description: How many of the section's assessments are not published (and so absent from assessments).

gpa.description: Credit-weighted grade points over graded final grades of the term, rounded half up to 2 decimals; omitted when they carry 0 credits.

credits.description: Credits of the graded final grades of the term.

sections.description: By course code, then section number.

cumulativeGpa.description: Over every graded final grade; omitted when they carry 0 credits.

displayName.description: Empty when the user has not set a name.

description.description: Plain text; trimmed; empty clears it.

body.example:
The midterm is now on Thursday in Room 101.
Bring a pencil.

emailed.description: Whether mail was queued when it was posted.

body.example: The midterm is now on Thursday in Room 101.

email.description: Omitted means true: mail everyone enrolled in or staffing the section, except the author.

body.example: The midterm is now on Thursday in Room 101.

items.description: By position; unpaginated (at most 100 weeks of at most 200 materials).

position.description: 1 to the number of weeks; the others are renumbered.

file.description: One file, 1 byte to the upload limit; extension as listed by GET /upload-policy.

title.description: Omitted or blank means the file name.

weekId.description: Another week of the same section; the file goes last unless position is given.

position.description: 1 to the number of files in the (target) week.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: Values below 1 mean 50, above 200 mean 200 (clamped by ParsePage); non-integer is 400 field limit.

q.name: q
q.description: Case-insensitive substring of the course code or title. Blank means no filter; over 100 characters is 400 field q.
